newsitem.title: USA: Race for Dole's Senate seat deadlocked, poll shows.
newsitem.headline: Race for Dole's Senate seat deadlocked, poll shows.

text.p: The race to succeed Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole as a U.S. Senator from Kansas was too close to call on Saturday, according to an independent poll.
The poll showed Republican Congressman Sam Brownback leading Democrat Jill Docking by 46 to 45 percent, with nine percent of those surveyed still undecided.
Kansas has not elected a Democrat to the Senate since the Great Depression.

The poll, conducted on behalf of the Kansas City Star newspaper by Mason-Dixon Political/Media Research Inc, was based on interviews with 812 registered Kansas voters and had a margin of error of plus or minus 3.5 percentage points.
In the state's race to succeed Sen. Nancy Kassebaum, Republican Congressman Pat Roberts had a 54-37 percent lead over Democrat Sally Thompson, with nine percent undecided, Saturday's poll said.
